title: Operational limits of reference renewal for retained quantum-service results
abstract: arXiv:2611.14376v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We implement reference renewal to reconsider retained physical quantum-service results under a prespecified protocol. Twelve transitions retained six results each; ten completed renewal, eight met the prespecified endpoint, and five succeeded using retained results alone. The exact one-sided p=0.0546875 does not establish the recovery hypothesis. Incomplete references, binding failures and sequential waits expose operational limits. Offline reconstruction recovers decisions from preserved counts. Retrospective binding-plus-oracle checking accepts all 60 usable-transition results without renewal. With the exact oracle also supplying calibration scores, the study does not demonstrate incremental numerical-correctness utility of renewal.

translated_title: 保留量子服务结果的参考更新之运作限制
translated_abstract: 我们在预定协议下实施参考更新，以重新审视保留的物理量子服务结果。十二个跃迁各保留了六个结果；其中十个完成了更新，八个达到预定终点，五个仅凭保留结果即告成功。精确的单侧 p 值 0.0546875 并不能确立恢复假设。不完整的参考、绑定失败和顺序等待暴露了运作上的限制。离线重建可从保留的计数中恢复决策。回顾性的“绑定加预言机”检查在无需更新的情况下接受了全部 60 个可用跃迁结果。鉴于精确预言机同时提供校准分数，本研究并未证明参考更新在数值正确性方面具有增量效用。
tldr: 本研究通过预定协议检验了对保留量子服务结果进行参考更新的可行性，发现其受不完整参考、绑定失败与顺序等待等运作限制，且回顾性绑定加预言机检查在无需更新时即可接受全部60个可用结果，故未证明参考更新具有数值正确性上的增量效用。
en_tdlr: This study tests reference renewal for retained quantum-service results under a prespecified protocol, revealing operational limits (incomplete references, binding failures, sequential waits) and showing that retrospective binding-plus-oracle checking accepts all 60 usable results without renewal, hence no incremental numerical-correctness utility of renewal is demonstrated.
